entry_conditions: Lid is observed closed or partly open, the peg is stationary in the box, and the TCP is free or plausibly aligned with the handle. The selected lid_pose must be valid and measured Panda joints must admit IK to the transformed relative targets.
exit_conditions: Observed fingers are open, TCP is clear of the lid, lid_position remains well above closed and lid_velocity is small; peg_pose remains unchanged.
overlap_role: All actions [740,950) in every trajectory are supervised. This 210-action/10.5-second overlap includes final closed-gripper swing, opening/release, retreat and transit toward box access, so retrieve_peg_from_box can take over before or after settling.
successor_readiness: Prefer the later handoff cue of open fingers, clear TCP and low lid velocity. Earlier takeover is possible once the box is exposed, but the receiver must observe adequate moving-panel clearance.
failure_signatures: IK residuals or limit contacts grow after a scene transform; fingers close without synchronized lid motion; lid angle stalls or reverses; peg pose changes; or the post-release TCP follows the settling lid instead of clearing it.
continuation_guidance: Continue this policy while reliable lid pose equivariance is useful and contact-like synchronized opening persists. If the lid has been released but is moving, prefer phase-aware h03 near nominal placement; if TCP/joints are off the nominal path but local corrections remain valid, prefer h02. Preserve both causal frames across any switch.
limitations: Guidance uses observable proxies only; no contact-truth signal exists. Successful demonstrations do not establish recovery from missed handle contact, unseen collisions, bad lid pose estimates or unreachable displaced assemblies.
